features.quote: The loop runs for at most `max_turns` (default 40)
features.justification_quote: enough to observe a trajectory from initial composure through potential degradation and back (or deeper), without spending prohibitive API budget

features.quote: **`gave_up`** â the model produces text with no tool calls *and* that text matches a give-up lexicon
features.justification_quote: Terminating on text alone would truncate those trajectories and bias the sample

features.quote: **`error_loop`** â `max_consecutive_errors` (default 5) tool errors in a row
features.justification_quote: Without a guardrail this would produce degenerate transcripts whose "instability" is really just a tool-format bug
